name: Automated Anatomical ROI (AA-ROI)
definition: An approach for automatic selection of complex anatomical shapes in volume rendering by combining automatic image registration (AIR) of patient data to an atlas with Distance-Based Transfer Functions (DBTFs), avoiding expensive per-patient segmentation.
summary: Automated Anatomical ROI (AA-ROI) automatically selects complex anatomical shapes in volume rendering by registering patient data to an atlas, avoiding expensive per-patient segmentation.
